a11y.text: A section named by its h2 with a list of offices; each is an article with an h3 city, a status (Open now or Closed, in text with an aria-live region), local time, an address element with a tel link, and opening hours in a table with a caption and row headers.
A copy address button announces its result in a role="status" region; the directions link opens a new tab and names the city in hidden text.
Without now, the clock is read after mount and updated each minute; the first render shows "--:--".
